newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SAMWAYS HOPING TO SIGN FOR LAS PALMAS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMWAYS HOPING TO SIGN FOR LAS PALMAS.

text.p: Midfielder Vinny Samways of English premier league Everton said on Wednesday he hoped to sign for Spanish club Las Palmas.
Samways, a former England under-21 player, has returned from a two-week trial with the Gran Canaria side and is now hoping the two clubs can agree on a fee to seal a permanent deal.
"I was very impressed with the players, the club, the place and obviously the climate at Las Palmas," Samways said.
"The coach is Argentinian and he has told me he wants me to join them. If the clubs can agree a fee, I have made up my mind to go. It's up to them.
"I have always said I would like to play abroad at some point in my career. Now seems a good time to go."
